subject: Pilot extension and hybrid bridge-hours proposal
messages:
From: Andrew Cole <andrew@lumosai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot extension request + bridge hours question

Hi Tessa —

Quick update from our side: the initial pilot has shown strong results for our summarization use-case, but we’ve hit a hard stop on throughput testing because our ingest volume spiked. We’re asking for a 3-week timebox extension to complete the last performance benchmarks.

Two asks: 1) can Redwood extend the pilot by 3 weeks, and 2) we’d prefer to purchase a small block of "bridge hours" (GPU-hours) at a discounted rate instead of raw token credits — that helps engineering plan burst tests.

Also attaching a short usage export so you can see the burst pattern (POC-usage-report.csv).

Budget is tight but we want to keep momentum. If there’s a sweet-spot (mix of time + hours + a small one-time discount) that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Andrew Cole
Head of AI Platforms
Lumos AI
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Cole <andrew@lumosai.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request + bridge hours question

Andrew — thank you, and great to see the early results. We can absolutely accommodate a short runway extension and offer a hybrid bridge-hours structure that tends to match customers running bursty benchmarks.

Proposed offer (summary):
- Timebox: +2 weeks (ending 2026-12-21)
- Bridge hours: 1,000 GPU-hours at $0.75/hr (standard list $1.10/hr) — effectively a 31.8% discount on the hour block
- One-time concession: 10% discount on the incremental invoice tied to the bridge block if Lumos signs the amendment by 2026-12-08
- Engineering support: 4 hours of dedicated infra time for integration troubleshooting (we can convert up to 300 of the bridge hours into eng hours if you prefer)

I’ve attached a short proposal PDF with the rate math (proposal-lumos-20261201.pdf) and a draft amendment that legal can redline. The proposal includes a DocuSign link to speed execution.

Next steps: if the mix above looks close, confirm whether you want the 300-hour swap to engineering support or keep full GPU-hours, and we’ll route for a quick approval from finance/legal.

Tessa Morgan
Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: proposal-lumos-20261201.pdf (proposal, 3 pages)
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request + bridge hours question

Tessa — quick internal note. I’m comfortable with the 1,000-hr block at the proposed discounted rate but recommend we cap the one-time concession at 12% instead of 10% if they sign by 12/08; we can absorb that in Q4 discretionary credits. Please flag if legal needs a stricter escrow for results. Finance will want the final invoice flow spelled out (prepay vs invoice).

If Lumos wants the 300-hour swap to engineering support, we should require a short SOW acceptance (1–2 paragraphs) to avoid scope creep.

—David
From: Andrew Cole <andrew@lumosai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumos AI Legal <legal@lumosai.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request + bridge hours question

Tessa — appreciate the quick turn. Lumos is good with the 2-week extension and would like to convert 300 GPU-hours into 6 engineering support hours (we’d rather get a couple pairing sessions to unblock our infra team). The only ask from legal is a short amendment clarifying data retention for the bridge hours and that logs remain customer-owned.

If Redwood can accept the 12% one-time concession (David’s note) and update the amendment with the data-retention clause, Lumos will sign by 12/08. Please send the redline-ready doc and the DocuSign link.

Thanks —
Andrew
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Cole <andrew@lumosai.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lumos AI Legal <legal@lumosai.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request + bridge hours question

Andrew — great, we’ll proceed as follows and I’ll circulate the formal amendment for signature:

Final terms (agreed):
- Timebox extension: +2 weeks (through 2026-12-21)
- Bridge block: 1,000 GPU-hours at $0.75/hr
- One-time concession: 12% off the incremental charge for the bridge block if signed by 2026-12-08
- Engineering conversion: 300 GPU-hours -> 6 hours of dedicated eng pairing/support (scope note attached)
- Data retention: logs and KV cache snapshots created from Lumos data remain Lumos property; Redwood will retain only aggregated telemetry for platform health unless otherwise requested in writing (see redlined-amendment.docx)

I’ve attached the redline (redlined-amendment.docx) and updated the DocuSign route: https://www.docusign.com/secure/propose/abc123-lumos

If legal signs off on the SOW paragraph for the eng support, we’ll route to finance and push the one-click sign by your Dec 8 deadline.

Thanks everyone — excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redlined-amendment.docx (amendment + SOW snippet)
